name: 1989 series short range, 25 yards
note: The book prints one size per ring in mm for edge touching, a centre dot of 1.00 mm that is no scoring ring, and the aiming mark as the black area; it states no ring colours and no inner ten. Its rings share the ratios of other faces the photo search tries, so the search skips it.

sources.note: The book lists the rings without values from the innermost, the 1st scoring ring, outward; the 1st scoring ring is the 10 and each ring outward one lower, as the short-range 25 metres column, whose last printed ring is a 6 (Rule 5.1.7.1), shows.
The 25 yards card holds 20 targets with one shot at each.

Outward gauging: the edge of the hole furthest from the centre decides; when the flange of the gauge touches the outside of the line the lower value counts, and a shot touching the outside of the lowest ring has no value.
The 5.6 mm gauge scores outward gauging targets.
